reason: The amplification mechanism, where AI-generated design documents look authoritative and unconfirmed assumptions harden into specification, still exists. On 2026-08-31 NIST SP 1353 ipd was found to ship prompt templates that generate compliance artifacts with no verification procedure, which is a fresh official instance. The remedies are current: RMD-A08-001 (provenance labelling and explicit acceptance), RMD-A13-001 (ADRs separating assumptions from decisions), RMD-A01-002 (official clarification phase) and RMD-A01-003 (cross-artifact analysis gate). None is rejected. There is no affirmative evidence of resolution. The model_improvement value 増幅 ('amplifies') implies more capable models make the problem worse.
